description: Use this when an author asks what Amazon KDP, IngramSpark or Lulu require for a print book: available trim sizes, interior bleed, margin and gutter minimums, page-count limits by binding and paper, spine-text minimum, and file rules (embedded fonts, 300 DPI images, file size, color, no encryption). Returns the platform's full requirement list with links to its official documentation.
name: get_platform_specs
title: Print platform specs
